title: Hallucination Mitigation with Agentic AI, Nested Learning, and AI Sustainability via Semantic Caching
abstract: arXiv:2605.29055v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper describes an approach to hallucination detection and mitigation using a HOPE-inspired Nested Learning architecture with Continuum Memory Systems (CMS) and semantic similarity caching, tested on a hybrid benchmark of 310 prompts (217 epistemic-uncertainty prompts, 93 fabrication-induction stress tests). A three-stage pipeline orchestrated via the Open Floor Protocol is evaluated with five KPIs; four score the response and aggregate into a Total Hallucination Score. The score improves end to end by 6.1% of its attainable range, but 83.5% of that gain is attributable to a single dimension, Explicit Contextualization, while Factual Claim Density, the dimension closest to unsupported content, stays flat; 97.7% of the gain arrives at the first review stage. The fifth indicator, observability, is reported separately, since it registers the presence of an OFP annotation channel rather than a property of the response: it rises 147%

translated_title: 幻觉缓解：基于代理AI、嵌套学习与语义缓存的AI可持续性
translated_abstract: 本文描述了一种幻觉检测与缓解方法，采用受HOPE启发的嵌套学习架构，结合连续记忆系统（CMS）和语义相似性缓存，并在一个由310个提示组成的混合基准（217个认知不确定性提示，93个捏造诱导压力测试）上进行了测试。通过开放地板协议编排的三阶段流水线，使用五个关键绩效指标进行评估；其中四个指标对响应进行评分，并汇总为总幻觉分数。该分数在其可达范围内端到端提升了6.1%，但其中83.5%的提升归因于单一维度——显式情境化，而与无根据内容最接近的事实声明密度维度则保持不变；97.7%的提升发生在首个审查阶段。第五个指标——可观测性——单独报告，因为它记录了OFP注释通道的存在而非响应的属性：该指标上升了147%。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合代理AI、嵌套学习与语义缓存的幻觉缓解方法，其总幻觉分数提升主要来自显式情境化维度，而非事实声明密度，且大部分改进发生在早期审查阶段。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hallucination mitigation approach integrating agentic AI, nested learning, and semantic caching, where score improvements stem mainly from explicit contextualization rather than factual claim density, with most gains occurring at the first review stage.
